experiment.title: Original stratified Iris training and evaluation
experiment.installCommand: python -m pip install numpy==1.26.4 scipy==1.11.4 scikit-learn==1.4.2 joblib==1.3.2 threadpoolctl==3.2.0
experiment.parameters: Original RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=200, random_state=1); disclosed Python 3.11 compatibility run vs README Python 3.12+, pinned runtime dependencies; PyYAML excluded because direct train/evaluate entries do not use it
experiment.seed: Original RANDOM_STATE=1 in both trainer and evaluator; stratify=y
experiment.protocol: Original sklearn Iris, stratified 120 train / 30 held-out test; same random_state=1 and test_size=0.2 in both scripts. Original evaluate.py loads new model.joblib and rounds its reported accuracy to two decimals. Compare that printed value with README example 0.97, not full precision or a paper benchmark.

evaluation.dataset: Built-in sklearn Iris, 150 rows; original stratified 80/20 split, random_state=1; 30 held-out test rows
evaluation.reference: https://github.com/Dorsumsellae/ml-pipeline/blob/40e84fd2333cca40614b9e20534b2ba2173a238c/README.md#L91 · expected printed output example, user-reviewed correspondence, not independently verified paper reference
